title: Tesla goes all-in on the Cybercab with upcoming €3B Berlin gigafactory expansion | TechCrunch
summary: Just two months after putting its first Cybercabs on the road, Tesla is making a multibillion-dollar bet on mass production of the golden-hued, two-seat autonomous vehicles. Tesla has so far taken a slow approach to its Cybercab rollout.
